1101018220838952961.a: Instead of blocking your xenophobic friends and relatives might I suggest just quietly reporting every single thing they repost that violates human decency and community standards. #YMMV If you can stomach it. You are unlikely to change their mind by engaging them directly. 😢

1101018222088851456.a: Ultimately, some people are so exhausted and distracted and inexperienced that they cannot hear reason and truth right now. They live in the upside down. All we can do is to lessen exposure to toxic influences like racism, expose them to true #humanity and hope they heal in time.
